cards.title: Damaged Circuitry
cards.text: When you recover [Energy] during the End Phase, recover 1 fewer [Energy], to a minimum of 0. Action: Repair this card.
cards.precisionText: The attacker chooses 1 of your [Hardpoint] upgrades that is not Offline. Flip that card.

cards.title: Scrambled Orders
cards.text: Before you engage, gain 2 jam tokens. Then repair this card.
cards.precisionText: The attacker chooses 1 of your [Hardpoint] upgrades that is not Offline. Flip that card.

cards.title: Hull Rupture
cards.text: After defending, if you suffered [Hit] or [Critical Hit] damage, suffer 1 additional [Hit] damage for each of your faceup damage cards. Then repair this card. Action: Repair this card.
cards.precisionText: The attacker chooses 1 of your [Hardpoint] upgrades that is not Offline. Flip that card.

cards.title: Stabilizers Damaged
cards.text: Increase the difficulty of your left and right maneuvers.

cards.title: Power Surge
cards.text: After you execute a maneuver, lose 1 [Energy] plus 1 [Energy] per ion token you have. Then repair this card.

cards.title: Engine Coolant Leak
cards.text: After you execute a speed 3-5 maneuver, roll 1 attack die. On a [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result, suffer 1 matching damage, then repair this card. Action: Repair this card.

cards.title: Panicked Crew
cards.text: You cannot gain green tokens or perform the [Coordinate] or [Jam] action. Action: Repair this card.

cards.title: Exploding Consoles
cards.text: After you perform an action, roll 1 attack die. On a [Hit] or [Critical Hit] result, suffer 1 [Hit] damage, then repair this card.

cards.title: Crew Shaken
cards.text: After you overlap a ship or obstacle, suffer 2 [Critical Hit] damage, then repair this card.

cards.title: Atmosphere Leak
cards.text: You cannot perform actions on your upgrade cards. Action: Repair this card.
cards.precisionText: Lose all [Charge] from each of your [Crew] upgrades. Lose all of your [Force].
